name: collapsible
description: An interactive component which expands and collapses a panel of content, built on Radix Collapsible. Use it for simple show/hide sections without the multi-item semantics of an accordion. Parts: Collapsible (root), CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent.

aria: The trigger manages aria-expanded and aria-controls for its content.
consumer: Use a button-like trigger with text that describes the hidden content.
